reason: User clarified the actual goal: EMER+Jev improves overall multi-objective recommendation, rather than requiring long-view gain in every seed
primary_metric: Equal-weight mean of six positive-goal weighted NDCG@3 values
negative_feedback_metric: Weighted top3 no-hate utility, reported separately because it is close to one
same_budget: Both arms use exactly the original three separately selected models; both evaluate the same two equal-weight aggregation rules; no learned ensemble weights
selection: Each arm independently maximizes six-goal mean on development validation; first recipe wins ties
confirmation_requirement: Freeze one final model and input protocol before evaluating fresh chronological data; positive six-goal mean difference lower95%CI and all seven point estimates nonnegative on that fresh set; report all individual intervals and sample support
interval_scope: Not a claim that all seven population effects are independently established as positive; development selection intervals are exploratory
